annotations.title: Vehicle registrations in Poland (Ministry of Digital Affairs, CEPiK)

description: First registrations of vehicles in Poland, monthly since 2014, from the Ministry of Digital Affairs files with CEPiK data: passenger cars and all vehicles, 17 vehicle types, provinces per 1000 residents, top passenger-car brands of the month and of 12 months (nationwide or one province) and the share of brands from China by province, with the finwire indices finwire_car_registrations_pulse (12-month passenger cars, change year on year) and finwire_chinese_brands_share. A first registration in Poland covers new cars and used cars imported from abroad. Months with an inconsistent province or type split are held back and listed. For electric cars use get_electric_vehicles.

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.

period.description: Month YYYY-MM of the brand ranking; default latest.

province.description: Province TERYT code 02-32 (e.g. 14 = mazowieckie) for the brand ranking; default Poland.
